text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought two shipments totalling 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender on Tuesday, Taipei traders said.

- Korea Flour Milling Corp said it bought 15,400 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Tuesday from Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp. A company official said arrival was set to the southwestern port of Mokpo. Shipment was slated for March 10-April 10 from the Pacific Northwest, the official said.

CORN SALES - South Korea bought 100,000 tonnes of Argentine corn for April to May shipment, Argentine traders said. The corn was bought in two 50,000-tonne lots, from Tradigrain at $133.95 and from Cargill at $136.50, they said.
- A group of South Korean feed milling companies bought 52,500 tonnes of corn but passed on a tender for another 52,500 tonnes, an official at one of the companies said.

WHEAT TENDER - Philippine firms invited tenders to buy 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said. The firms asked for price quotes from commodity houses for 29,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat and 6,000 tonnes of western white wheat.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it was seeking up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 soft white wheat, 13.5 pct moisture, for Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for February 20 to March 15.
- Pakistan will hold side-by-side tenders for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat, the country's shipping agent said.
Bids for both tenders will be opened on February 16 and must be valid the following day on February 17. Shipment for both tenders was slated for March 5-31.

WHEAT TENDER - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 40,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale. An international call set February 12 as the final date for bids had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on February 13.

- The CCC will tender February 5 for 2,170 tonnes of No.2 hard red winter wheat, ordinary protein, for donation to Uganda. The donation will be made under the World Food Program and will be shipped March 1-25.

WHEAT TENDER - Sri Lanka has opened a tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, for delivery in two lots of hard and soft wheat, an official for the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The tender, for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat, will close on February 7.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey has cancelled a tender for the export of 150,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley for shipment in February and March, European grain traders said.
CORN TENDERS - Algeria is in the market to import 43,000 tonnes of corn for March 1-10 shipment, European traders said.

CORN TENDER - The CCC said it seeks to buy 27,170 tonnes of No. 2 yellow corn for donation to Uganda, Mozambique and Angola. Offers are due on February 5. The CCC said 10,000 tonnes will be donated to Uganda, 9,260 to Mozambique and 7,910 to Angola. Shipment of all three lots was to be March 1-25.

SOYBEAN OIL - The CCC said it would tender February 11 for 11,670 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil under its export program to Peru. The delivery period was slated for March 20 to April 5. The tender was for reply on February 12.

SORGHUM TENDERS - The CCC would seek 15,000 tonnes of U.S. no 2 or better sorghum, of which 5,000 tonnes would be for donation to Uganda and 10,000 tonnes for Ethiopia. The shipment period was March 1-25 and offers due on Feb 5.

RICE TENDERS - Colombia is preparing to tender for up to 50,000 tonnes of rice to help cover a shortfall in domestic production, Agriculture Ministry sources said. They said a formal announcement regarding the tender was expected to be made by Agriculture Minister Cecilia Lopez sometime next week. -

U.S. rice traders and exporters confirmed Iraq tendered on Monday for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain white milled rice, broken 10 percent maximum, under the nation's "food for oil" program with the U.N. Offers are to be opened through February 5. The tender was divided into two 15,000-tonne positions, with one for April delivery and for May delivery.

RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs has issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment in April. March 3 was set as the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be made on March 12.
